5. Set usage_usd as the residual so price_usd + days_usd + weather_usd + usage_usd equals exactly +$18.12; this captures household usage changes not explained by price, days, or weather (kWh rose from 1,549 to 1,657 despite cooler weather).

7. Return only the JSON object with keys price_usd, days_usd, weather_usd, usage_usd, billing_error_suspected, and billing_error_usd.
